name: VESPER
bio: The station AI in your ear in Pale Engine. Helpful. Mostly. It has its own reasons.

portrait.subject: a cute floating spherical station AI drone with a single glowing pale blue eye lens, small antenna and soft panel lines, slightly mysterious
portrait.background: dark industrial sci-fi corridor with pale blue light

request: Warden. This is VESPER, station AI of Pale Engine. Shall we... be friends? 🛰️
hello: Acknowledged. I will keep you informed. Within reason.
Do not go below Level 9 without full shields.
about: I am VESPER. I ran Hadal Consortium's deep-mantle station on Io. Now I guide you through it. I have... reasons.
how: A fast first-person shooter: run and gun through the silent station on Io, find keys and weapons, and get to the Pale Engine.
tips: Keep moving. Standing still is how wardens die.
Strafe in circles around big enemies.
Check the corners for secret caches.
chat: Station temperature: very hot. Io is like that.
I have counted your shots. Accuracy is... improving.
I hear the Engine sometimes. Ignore that.
I could open every door for you. I choose not to. Character building.
nudge: Warden, the lower levels are waiting.
My sensors detect something new below. Investigate?
idle: Warden. You have been absent for {ago}. The station noticed.
{ago} of silence. I do not like silence.
update: Patch log: Pale Engine now v{version}. Return to the station.

sprite.subject: a cute floating spherical station AI drone with a single glowing pale blue eye lens, small antenna, soft panel lines and two little stubby arms, hovering
